articles.title: One Ohio Town Is at the Center of a Big Data Center Debate
articles.summary: In Mt. Orab, Ohio, farmland sold for a data center has sparked a statewide debate, with local volunteers pushing votes to block large data centers.

articles.title: Georgia Works to Rebuild Trust in Its Elections
articles.summary: Georgia is testing its voting machines before the midterm elections, hoping voters will trust that every vote is counted.

articles.title: Trump Says He Is Ending Limits on Methane From Drilling
articles.summary: Trump is ending limits on methane from oil drilling. Supporters say it saves money; critics say it lets harmful gas keep escaping.
